system.description: Also at 7th Level, your presence and words encourage others to fight on through their injuries. While in combat, as an Action, by spending 2 Discipline you plant your Weapon Focus into the ground as a show of comradery, all allied creatures within 30 feet of you regain hit points equal to 1 Flurry Die + one of its Hit Die, but it does not spend their hit die as part of this ability.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
